title.suggested: Jem Mace in St. Louis; Tom Allen's Saloon His Favorite Resort

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Jem Mace had arrived in St. Louis to keep in condition before his rescheduled June 2 fight with Joe Coburn at Kansas City, and that Tom Allen's saloon was his favorite resort in town.

metadata.notes: Same page as article 434: masthead 'Daily Democrat', Saturday Morning, May 27, 1871. Mace arrived 'yesterday' (May 26). Current title implies Mace trained at Allen's saloon; the article says he lodged at the 'Wash Home' and only frequented Allen's saloon.

facts.fact: While in St. Louis before his Kansas City match with Joe Coburn, Jem Mace made Tom Allen's saloon his favorite resort

notes: Allen is mentioned only once; the item is about Mace.
